groups.activity: finish Vox Solaris, then rank Solaris United to Old Mate

rows.label: Vox Solaris
rows.note: unlocks Legs, The Business and Eudico's bounties

conditions: Every rank-up from Cove to Old Mate sacrifices 6 Training, 9 Shelter, 11 Medical, 10 Advances and 5 Familial Debt-Bonds plus 385,000 credits total.
Since the 2024 changes, bonds drop only from bounty stages 2-5, best odds on the final stage; the old 'run stage 1 and reset' trick no longer works.

disclosures.title: check Ticker every visit
disclosures.body: Ticker sells debt-bonds for credits and resources and always shows at least one uncommon and one rare case since Update 35.5. Several players hit Old Mate almost entirely through Ticker.

groups.activity: mine blue veins, fish ponds and cave hotspots
groups.meta: one full trip covers the whole build

rows.label: Star Crimzian
rows.note: Plains of Eidolon gem, refined at Old Man Suumbaat (Ostron Rank 3)
rows.alt: tradeable, unconfirmed if anyone actually sells it

rows.label: Star Amarast
rows.note: refine raw Amarast with Smokefinger's blueprint, 4,000 standing

rows.label: Recaster Neural Relay
rows.note: dismantle Recaster servofish, Cold-weather pond hotspots with The Business

rows.label: Synathid Ecosynth Analyzer
rows.note: dismantle a Synathid, cave hotspots any weather

conditions: Star Crimzian is mined in the Plains of Eidolon, not the Vallis; the wiki lists it as tradeable but I could not confirm anyone selling it.
Recasters only spawn in Cold weather; Warm is a short ~4-minute phase of the ~26-minute cycle, so just wait it out.
The Sunpoint Plasma Drill from Smokefinger needs no syndicate rank and mines 'very rare' gems in both open worlds; buy it before the Nosam Cutters.
bonuses: The Exploiter Orb fight (Diluted Thermia at Deck 12) is available below Rank 5 and drops the Synathid Ecosynth Analyzers directly, though it's squad-oriented.

rows.label: Helstrum
rows.note: 50,000 cr, 10 Star Crimzian, 10 Star Amarast, 10 Recaster Neural Relay, 1 Synathid Ecosynth Analyzer

conditions: Needs a free Companion inventory slot, not a weapon slot.

disclosures.title: is it still worth it
disclosures.body: An April 2026 thread argues Tazicor has replaced Helstrum as the go-to AoE status primer: faster status application and instant hits against Helstrum's 10 m/s rockets and one volley every 4.4 seconds. Defenders point to innate Heat for viral/heat builds and energy-generator Dethcube setups.
